summary: The filing is a Form 6-K submitted by Honda Motor Co., Ltd. providing notice of its 102nd Ordinary General Meeting of Shareholders scheduled for June 26, 2026. It includes the meeting agenda, such as approval of financial statements and election of 11 directors (including 6 outside directors), but contains no tender offer, merger, or other special-situation transaction. The meeting allows virtual attendance and advance voting via internet or mail. As a routine meeting notice and proxy circular, this filing does not constitute a special situation.
